you_should_know.title: Trump approves West Virginia’s $4.5 million disaster declaration request in Upshur, Lewis counties
you_should_know.summary: FEMA is also evaluating disaster declaration requests in five other counties. Trump approves West Virginia's $4.5 million disaster declaration request in Upshur and Lewis counties, both roughly 60–80 miles south of Wheeling, WV in the north-central part of the state.

you_should_know.title: Governor Morrisey embarks on water listening tour in southern West Virginia
you_should_know.summary: HUNTINGTON, W.Va – Governor Patrick Morrisey is headed through southern West Virginia (the region well south of Wheeling, WV, more than 200 miles away) this week to hear from residents and local officials about the challenges facing water infrastructure in the region. Morrisey kicked off the tour in Huntington, a city on the Ohio River about 200 miles southwest of Wheeling, WV, on Tuesday and called assuring clean water for West Virginians a key component moving forward.

you_should_know.summary: Republicans in Fayette County, in south-central West Virginia roughly 175 miles south of Wheeling, WV, have named candidates to serve the unexpired term for the 50th House district seat, which expires this year.
